edges.description: The activating mutations increase USP8 deubiquitinase activity.
Increased USP8 activity deubiquitinates EGFR and impairs receptor downregulation.
Sustained EGFR signaling increases POMC promoter activity.
Increased POMC transcription supports increased ACTH production and secretion.
